summary: John's 8th-great-grandmother (if the Doll link holds); of the Schuch family of Ulmet.
bio: Mother of Johann Casper Doll. Her Schuch kin apparently sailed with Casper in 1739: 'Christ. Shook, 48' on the Samuel list; a Johann Christian Jacob Schuch b. 4 May 1690 at Ulmet, d. 1768 Springfield Twp, Bucks Co. (GEDBAS 1402009472, from an Ancestry tree).
sources: WikiTree Doll-527 (Johann Casper Doll; FamilySearch N5BL-88G): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Doll-527
Strassburger & Hinke, Pennsylvania German Pioneers vol. 1: https://archive.org/details/pennsylvaniagerm42stra List 69 A
